login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Your tickets and orders are waiting. Organizers use the same login and land on their dashboard.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: One account for buying tickets or selling them.

buyer.title: I want to buy tickets
buyer.text: Find events, pay in a minute and keep your QR codes in one place.

organizer.title: I want to organize events
organizer.text: Publish events, set ticket tiers and scan tickets at the door.

signup.approvalText: After you sign up, an admin reviews your account. You can create events once it is approved.
signup.organizationHint: The organization name and address are shown publicly on your profile and events.
signup.noEmail: We will email a confirmation link to this address. Buying tickets needs a confirmed email.
signup.agree: I agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and have read the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.

pending.title: Your organizer account is being reviewed
pending.text: An admin checks every new organizer before events can be created. Until there is a decision you can log in, but Create event stays locked.
pending.stepDecision: Decision after review. If approved, Create event unlocks.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Log in again to continue.
errors.termsRequired: Agree to the Terms and the Privacy policy to continue.
errors.notVerified: Your account was not verified. Please contact support.
errors.alreadyUsed: An account with this email, name or phone already exists. Log in instead.
errors.network: We could not reach Ticketzy. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.serviceUnavailable: Ticketzy is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
errors.validationFailed: Some of the information is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.rateLimitedSoon: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.rateLimitedSeconds_one: Too many requests. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.rateLimitedSeconds_other: Too many requests. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.rateLimitedMinutes_one: Too many requests. Try again in {{count}} minute.
errors.rateLimitedMinutes_other: Too many requests. Try again in {{count}} minutes.

sell.title: Sell tickets on Ticketzy
sell.buyerLead: You are logged in with a buyer account. Organizer accounts are separate from buyer accounts, so selling tickets needs its own sign-up.
sell.buyerSteps: To register an organizer account, log out first, then choose “Organizer” on the sign-up page. Use a different email address than your buyer account.
sell.buyerAction: Log out and register as an organizer
sell.outLead: Sell tickets to your own concert, match or show. We review every organizer before the first event goes live.
sell.organizerLead: You are logged in as an organizer. Create and manage your events from your dashboard.
sell.adminLead: You are logged in as an admin. Organizer accounts are managed in the admin panel.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox to confirm your email
checkInbox.text: We sent you a link. Open it to confirm your email.
checkInbox.textTo: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your email.
checkInbox.spam: Nothing there? Look in your spam folder, or ask for a new link below.
checkInbox.browseNote: You can browse events now. Buying tickets unlocks once your email is confirmed.
checkInbox.organizerNote: Also check your inbox: confirm your email so an admin can approve your account.

verify.doneText: Thank you. You can now buy tickets.
verify.changedText: Use the new address the next time you log in.
verify.invalidTitle: This link has expired or was already used
verify.invalidText: Links work once and for a limited time. Ask for a new one.
verify.missingText: Open the link from your email again, or ask for a new one.
verify.alreadyConfirmed: Your email is already confirmed, so you do not need a new link.
verify.invalidLogIn: Log in to ask for a new link.
verify.failedTitle: We could not confirm your email
verify.failedText: Check your connection and try again. The link has not been used up.
verify.limitedText: Wait a moment, then try again.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you signed up with. We will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentText: If an account exists for this email, we sent a reset link. Check your inbox and spam.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You will be logged out everywhere and can log in with the new password.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.doneText: Log in with your new password.
reset.invalidTitle: This link has expired or was already used
reset.invalidText: Reset links work once and for a limited time. Ask for a new one.
reset.missingText: Open the link from your email again, or ask for a new one.
